messages:
maria_support: Heads up — multiple customers reporting spikes of 503/504 and timeouts to /v1/generate since the staged rollout started ~20m ago. Some include billing complaints (retries counted). :rotating_light:

sam_oncall: seeing the same in Grafana. 5xx rate went from ~0.2% to 12% in the last 15m for the hosted cluster in us-west-2. Latency P95 jumped from 180ms -> 1.8s.

jia_eng: can you paste a sample request_id from a failing request? need to trace through the router + gateway.

maria_support: customer_a sent this: request_id=ri_2026_03_17_9a1c, curl attached. They say it times out, then client retries 3x and got charged for each attempt.

maria_support: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cus-xxxx" -d '{"prompt":"foo"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate```

ryan_sre: checking envoy traces. There's a pattern: upstream auth service returning 401 for some requests but gateway translates to 503 on short path. Also seeing a surge of retry traffic from the client lib causing queue saturation.

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: rolling config-update canary v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2 started by jia_eng 20m ago. Flags changed: cache_ttl_override=true, auth_token_prefetch=on

jia_eng: I pushed a canary that enables cache_ttl_override so some frontends serve cached responses without validating auth token expiry. Hypothesis: TTL override is serving cached entries with expired auth-bound metadata, upstream now rejects and triggers errors.

olivia_product: :eyes: Did we limit the canary to 5%? It looks like staging slice got 40% due to seed weight misapply earlier.

sam_oncall: confirmed: seed weight drifted — routing matrix shows 35% to canary pools in us-west-2. That matches the customer geography.

noah_billing: customers report duplicate charges from retries. We should pause billing ingestion for failed attempts until we confirm root cause. Can we tag and exclude retry-counted hits?

jia_eng: immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip cache_ttl_override=false in global config 2) rollback canary to v2.3.1 if config flip doesn't drop 5xx in 5m 3) throttle client retries at gateway (shedder) 4) capture repro + request ids for billing dispute.

ryan_sre: working on quick config flip. Pushing change to config-store now.

deploy-bot: Config change applied: cache_ttl_override=false by ryan_sre at 1757772488.

sam_oncall: after flip, 5xx dropped to 3.4% in 2m but still elevated. There are still spike clusters correlated with token refresh failures.

jia_eng: rolling full rollback to v2.3.1 across us-west-2. Triggering now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: release v2.3.1 -> all nodes us-west-2. Started by jia_eng at 1757772509.

maria_support: communicating to affected customers: apologizing, offering credits, asking for request_ids they have.

noah_billing: temporarily paused billing ingestion for the period 1757772400-1757772600 for detected retries. Filing disputes queue for impacted customers.

ryan_sre: post-rollback telemetry looks normal in control clusters. In the canary cluster p95 back to 210ms, 5xx ~0.4%. We'll keep monitoring 30m.

olivia_product: record lessons: (1) cache flags that interact with auth must have unit tests + staging gate, (2) enforce seed weight guardrails to 0-10% for canaries to avoid scope creep.

jia_eng: repro notes for postmortem: minimal reproducer (shared):
```bash
# reproduce locally against canary slice
export REDWOOD_API=https://canary.us-west-2.api.redwood.example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-expired" -d '{"prompt":"test"}' $REDWOOD_API/v1/generate -v
# observe 401 from auth, gateway returns 503 for short-circuit path
```

maria_support: customer follow-up template prepared and queued.

sam_oncall: assigning follow-ups: jia_eng to own codefix, ryan_sre to monitoring alerts + rollback proof, olivia_product to customer comms, noah_billing to reconcile charges.

jia_eng: quick patch will add auth-bound cache validation and a canary cap. I'll open PR and attach QA checklist. :shipit:

maria_support: thanks team — closing incident channel when 30m of stable telemetry and billing reconciliation confirmed. :white_check_mark:
